description: This file provides HTTP header manipulation interfaces, including functions for parsing, getting, setting, appending, and removing HTTP headers in requests and responses, as well as handling header normalization and related utilities.

methods.name: enum:http_header_e http_header_hkey_get(const char * const s,const size_t slen)
methods.description: Returns the enum value for a header name, case-insensitive, based on known headers array.

methods.name: enum:http_header_e http_header_hkey_get_lc(const char * const s,const size_t slen)
methods.description: Returns the enum value for a header name, case-sensitive, optimized for lowercase headers.

methods.name: int http_header_str_to_code(const char * const s)
methods.description: Converts a 3-digit string to its numerical HTTP status code.

methods.name: int http_header_str_contains_token(const char * const s,const uint32_t slen,const char * const m,const uint32_t mlen)
methods.description: Checks if a header string contains a specific token, ignoring whitespace and case.

methods.name: int http_header_remove_token(buffer * const b,const char * const m,const uint32_t mlen)
methods.description: Removes all instances of a token from a header buffer, replacing them with spaces or removing the header entirely.

methods.name: buffer * http_header_response_get(const request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Retrieves a header value from the response headers of a request object.

methods.name: buffer * http_header_response_set_ptr(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Sets a response header's value to an empty buffer for modification.

methods.name: void http_header_response_unset(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Removes a header from the response headers.

methods.name: void http_header_response_set(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen,const char * v,uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Sets a specific response header to a given value.

methods.name: void http_header_response_append(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen,const char * v,uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Appends a value to a response header, handling multiple header fields.

methods.name: buffer * http_header_request_get(const request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Retrieves a header value from the request headers.

methods.name: buffer * http_header_request_set_ptr(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Prepares a request header for modification by setting an empty buffer.

methods.name: void http_header_request_unset(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Removes a header from the request headers.

methods.name: void http_header_request_set(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen,const char * v,uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Sets a request header to a specific value.

methods.name: void http_header_request_append(request_st * const r,enum http_header_e id,const char * k,uint32_t klen,const char * v,uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Appends a value to a request header.

methods.name: buffer * http_header_env_get(const request_st * const r,const char * k,uint32_t klen)

methods.name: buffer * http_header_env_set_ptr(request_st * r,const char * k,uint32_t klen)

methods.name: void http_header_env_set(request_st * const r,const char * k,uint32_t klen,const char * v,uint32_t vlen)

methods.name: void http_header_env_append(request_st * const r,const char * k,uint32_t klen,const char * v,uint32_t vlen)
